name: studytok-companion
description: StudyTok Companion - Learning buddy website with Pomodoro timer and learning tips

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.minify:js: terser js/main.js --compress --mangle -o js/main.min.js && terser js/shop.js --compress --mangle -o js/shop.min.js && terser js/timer.js --compress --mangle -o js/timer.min.js && terser js/tipps.js --compress --mangle -o js/tipps.min.js && terser js/utils.js --compress --mangle -o js/utils.min.js
scripts.minify:css: cleancss -o css/style.min.css css/style.css && cleancss -o css/timer.min.css css/timer.css && cleancss -o css/tipps.min.css css/tipps.css && cleancss -o css/lernplan.min.css css/lernplan.css && cleancss -o css/utils.min.css css/utils.css

author: StudyTok Team
